text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, hey! What're ya<n>freaked out for?!
Good ol' Golshi<n>here's trying to wish ya a happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah, but you're going about it allnormal. That's what's weird.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi just... wanted Jordan to be...<n>h-happy...
Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real, would you quit it with the<n>fake tears? The
only person who'd<n>fall for that is, like, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're spoiling all the fun.<n>Well,
whatever—I put your present in<n>your room, so don't
forget to open it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing crazy, geez. Just a<n>bucket full of natto
beans. Oh, and I<n>stirred it around 100 times so it's
extra slimy. ☆
